verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner: the logo sits on the left and the headline and CTA form a right-hand block whose edges line up. Its flaws are that the logo is a bit oversized and competes with the headline, and the text block sits close to the right edge. B blows the headline up so it wraps, leaving 'Light' alone on its own line. The headline is jammed near the top, the CTA crowds the bottom edge, and the tiny logo floats in a large empty left area, so the layout is lopsided and cramped.
